verdict.rationale: Framer has a live, probe-verified llms.txt (HTTP 200) that presents an agent-oriented index with markdown mirrors of pages via ?md and links to /agents/ and /agents/external/ docs explicitly designed for AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to consume. This is corroborated by both docs claims and an independent runtime probe. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully in a real workflow (only first-party/probe evidence exists).
